messages:
sophie: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 502s on hosted /v1/generate since ~09:12 UTC. Appears during streaming bursts. Example trace_id=tr-8a1b, client=tbb-inc. Repro via curl below. Any quick checks?

james: Oncall here, looking now. Can you paste sanitized curl + response and a couple trace ids? Is it upstream reset or 502 body?

sophie: sanitized curl: ```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'Model: gpt-x' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
response: ```HTTP/2 502
server: envoy
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream reset: connection reset by peer"}```
Trace ids: tr-8a1b, tr-8a2c, tr-8a7f. Seen in us-west1 + eu-west1.

liam: Noting h2 pool saturation signature — active streams spiking on frontdoor + many half-open upstream connections. Will pull envoy stats and h2 metrics now.

james: also checking auth and billing latencies. If auth backend is slow we get head-of-line on h2 and resets.

sophie: Looking at logs for those traces — auth lookup latencies ~1.2–1.6s before the reset. Billing header injection for the tenant shows retries around same time.

robert-oncall: Correlating traces — billing service 500s during bursts, auth retries balloon, and envoy starts ejecting upstreams -> resets. Pattern: billing -> auth slow -> h2 pool exhausted -> 502 upstream reset.

liam: Quick mitigation: increase upstream connection pool and enable short TTL auth cache for streaming clients. Also propose turning on a temporary bypass for billing lookup on high-throughput tenants.

deploy-bot: Flag rollout started: "skip-billing-lookup-on-burst" -> true for hostedapi-prod clusters (canary -> 4 clusters) at 09:27:12 UTC.

sophie: After rollout customers report fewer 502s. Error rate for affected tenants dropped noticeably. Sending update to customer success. :thumbsup:

liam: Metrics: pre-mitigation 5xx rate ~5.8% on /v1/generate for the tenant; post-flag ~0.9% within 10m window. Need longer window but promising.

james: Next actions: capture pcap/traces for the window, schedule NGINX/Envoy change to raise max_concurrent_streams and tune keepalive, and add a circuit-breaker on billing backend. Assigning to @liam and @robert-oncall.

sophie: I'll file support ticket + customer comms with repro steps and link traces. Thanks all. :pray:
